استعذيت (form X)
# اِسْتَعْذَيْتُ (istaʕḏaytu) /is.taʕ.ðaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
# اِسْتَعْذَيْتَ (istaʕḏayta) /is.taʕ.ðaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
# اِسْتَعْذَيْتِ (istaʕḏayti) /is.taʕ.ðaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
# اُسْتُعْذِيتُ (ustuʕḏītu) /us.tuʕ.ðiː.tu/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
